# list_subtracks { #geneinfo.ucsc.list_subtracks }

```python
geneinfo.ucsc.list_subtracks(track_name, assembly)
```

Return a DataFrame of leaf subtracks under a composite/view container.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**track_name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Name of a composite or view container track.

<code>[**assembly**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Genome assembly, e.g. ``'hg38'``.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[pandas](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Columns ``name``, ``type``, ``shortLabel``, one row per subtrack that holds data. Empty for a track that is not a container.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[KeyError](`KeyError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the track does not exist in the assembly.
